sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.get: select cfg.*, cfg.group_name as original_group_name, cot.object_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.use_parent_data as "useParentData", cfga.id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfot.id as "customFieldObjectTypeId", null as "processStepName", null as "groupName" FROM brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join brs.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfga.archived is not true AND cfot.archived is not true and cfot.object_type_id = :objectTypeId union all SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.use_parent_data as "useParentData", cfga.id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf2.field_name as "fieldName", cfot2.id as "customFieldObjectTypeId", ps.process_step_name as "processStepName", cfg2.group_name as "groupName" FROM brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga2 on cfga2.id = cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join flow.custom_field cf2 on cf2.id = cfga2.custom_field_id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg2 on cfg2.id = cfga2.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field_object_type cfot2 on cfot2.custom_field_id = cf2.id and cfot2.company_object_type_id = cfg2.company_object_type_id left join flow.process_step ps on cfg2.process_step_id = ps.id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = 27 AND cfga.archived is not true AND cfga2.archived is not true AND cfot2.archived is not true ORDER BY "fieldOrder", "fieldName" ) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from brs.custom_field_group cfg inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.object_type_id where cot.id = :objectTypeId and cfg.archived is not true order by cfg.group_order, cfg.group_name
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.insertCustomFi: insert into brs.custom_field_group(group_name, object_type_id, group_order, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:groupName, :objectTypeId, (select coalesce(max(group_order) + 1, 0) from brs.custom_field_group where object_type_id = :objectTypeId), :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.updateCustomFi: update brs.custom_field_group set group_name = :groupName, group_order = :groupOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.get: select cfg.*, ot.object_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfot.id as "customFieldObjectTypeId" FROM brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join brs.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfga.archived is not true) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from brs.custom_field_group cfg inner join brs.object_type ot on ot.id = cfg.object_type_id where cfg.id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.del: update brs.custom_field_group_assignment set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.deleteCustomFi: update brs.custom_field_group set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.get: select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfot.object_type_id from brs.custom_field_object_type cfot inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfot.custom_field_id inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfot.object_type_id where cot.id = :companyObjectTypeId and cfot.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true except select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfg.object_type_id from brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.object_type_id where cot.id = :companyObjectTypeId and cfga.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true and cfg.archived is not true order by field_name

SELECT cfga.id, cfga.id as custom_field_group_assignment_id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name, cfg.group_name, cot.object_type as "objectType" FROM brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join brs.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.object_type_id WHERE cfga.id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.add: insert into brs.custom_field_group_assignment(custom_field_group_id, custom_field_id, ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id, field_order, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:customFieldGroupId, :customFieldId, :ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId, (select coalesce(max(field_order) + 1, 0) from brs.custom_field_group_assignment where custom_field_group_id = :customFieldGroupId and archived is not true), :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.upd: update brs.custom_field_group_assignment set field_order = :fieldOrder, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.sav: update brs.custom_field_group_assignment set use_parent_data = :useParentData, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :cfgaId
